rca_of_the_issue: Mini-map not showing on detail pages was caused by 302 redirect from /api/map/static-image. Native Image component doesn't follow redirects properly. Fixed by proxying the actual image bytes from Google Maps API and returning them with 200 status. FlatList-in-ScrollView error was caused by nesting VirtualizedLists - fixed by replacing FlatList with ScrollView+map pattern.
